source.text: Ταύτην ἤδη, ἀγαπητοί, δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν, ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν, μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος, τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπ’ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι καὶ λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: This now, beloved, second to you I write letter, in which I stir up of you in reminder the sincere mind, \v 2 to remember the having been spoken beforehand words by the holy prophets and the of the apostles of you command of the Lord and Savior, \v 3 this first knowing, that will come in last of the days in scoffing scoffers according to the own desires of them going \v 4 and saying, Where is the promise of the coming of him?

en.L: This [is] now, beloved, [the] second letter I am writing to you, in which [letters] I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of reminder, \v 2 to remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets, and the command of the Lord and Savior [given] through your apostles, \v 3 knowing this first, that in [the] last days scoffers will come with scoffing, going according to their own desires \v 4 and saying, "Where is the promise of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming?
en.B: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. In both of them I am trying to rouse your minds to clear thinking by reminding you \v 2 to remember what the holy prophets said long ago, and the command of the Lord and Savior that your apostles passed on to you. \v 3 Above all, understand this: in the last days scoffers will come, full of scorn, living by their own desires. \v 4 They will say, "Where is this promise of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming?
en.R: Dear friends, this is the second letter I have written to you. In both letters I want to wake up your minds and help you think clearly by reminding you of what you already know. \v 2 Remember the words that God's holy prophets spoke long ago. Remember too the command that the Lord and Savior gave you through your apostles. \v 3 Most of all, you need to know this: in the last days people will come who laugh and sneer. They will live only to please themselves. \v 4 They will say, "Jesus promised to come back. What happened to that promise?

es.L: Esta es ya, amados, [la] segunda carta que {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo, en las cuales [cartas] despierto con un recordatorio {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mente sincera, \v 2 para que {{plural_you:recuerden|recordéis}} las palabras dichas de antemano por los santos profetas, y el mandamiento del Señor y Salvador [dado] por medio de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} apóstoles, \v 3 sabiendo esto primero: que en [los] últimos días vendrán burladores con burla, andando según sus propios deseos \v 4 y diciendo: «¿Dónde está la promesa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida?
es.B: Queridos, esta es ya la segunda carta que {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo. En ambas procuro despertar en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} un pensar limpio y claro por medio de recordatorios, \v 2 para que {{plural_you:recuerden|recordéis}} lo que dijeron hace tiempo los santos profetas, y el mandamiento del Señor y Salvador que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} apóstoles {{plural_you:les|os}} transmitieron. \v 3 Sobre todo, {{plural_you:entiendan|entended}} esto: en los últimos días vendrán burladores llenos de burla, que vivirán según sus propios deseos. \v 4 Dirán: «¿Dónde está esa promesa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida?
es.R: Queridos amigos, esta es la segunda carta que {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo. En las dos quiero despertar {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mente y ayudar{{plural_you:los|os}} a pensar con claridad, recordándo{{plural_you:les|os}} lo que ya {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}}. \v 2 {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} las palabras que los santos profetas de Dios dijeron hace mucho tiempo. {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} también el mandamiento que el Señor y Salvador {{plural_you:les|os}} dio por medio de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} apóstoles. \v 3 Sobre todo, {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que saber esto: en los últimos días vendrá gente que se ríe y se burla. Vivirán solo para darse gusto a sí mismos. \v 4 Dirán: «Jesús prometió que volvería. ¿Qué pasó con esa promesa?

sw.L: Hii sasa, wapendwa, ni barua ya pili ninayowaandikia; katika [barua] hizo ninaichochea akili yenu iliyo safi kwa ukumbusho, \v 2 mkumbuke maneno yaliyosemwa kabla na manabii watakatifu, na amri ya Bwana na Mwokozi [iliyoletwa] kupitia mitume wenu, \v 3 mkijua hili kwanza, kwamba katika siku za mwisho watakuja wadhihaki kwa dhihaka, wakienenda kwa kufuata tamaa zao wenyewe \v 4 na kusema, "Ahadi ya kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} iko wapi?
sw.B: Wapendwa, hii sasa ni barua yangu ya pili kwenu. Katika barua zote mbili ninajitahidi kuziamsha akili zenu ziwe safi na wazi kwa kuwakumbusha \v 2 myakumbuke yale ambayo manabii watakatifu walisema zamani, na amri ya Bwana na Mwokozi ambayo mitume wenu waliwaletea. \v 3 Zaidi ya yote, fahamuni hili: katika siku za mwisho watakuja wadhihaki, wamejaa dhihaka, wakiishi kwa kufuata tamaa zao wenyewe. \v 4 Watasema, "Ahadi hii ya kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} iko wapi?
sw.R: Wapendwa wangu, hii ni barua ya pili ambayo nimewaandikia. Katika barua zote mbili nataka kuziamsha akili zenu na kuwasaidia mfikiri kwa uwazi, kwa kuwakumbusha mambo ambayo tayari mnayajua. \v 2 Kumbukeni maneno ambayo manabii watakatifu wa Mungu walisema zamani sana. Kumbukeni pia amri ambayo Bwana na Mwokozi aliwapa kupitia mitume wenu. \v 3 Zaidi ya yote, mnahitaji kujua hili: katika siku za mwisho watakuja watu wanaocheka na kudhihaki. Wataishi kwa kujifurahisha wenyewe tu. \v 4 Watasema, "Yesu aliahidi kurudi. Ahadi hiyo imekuwaje?

fr.L: Voici déjà, bien-aimés, [la] deuxième lettre que je vous écris ; dans [ces lettres] je réveille par un rappel votre pensée sincère, \v 2 pour que vous vous souveniez des paroles dites d’avance par les saints prophètes, et du commandement du Seigneur et Sauveur [transmis] par vos apôtres, \v 3 sachant d’abord ceci : dans [les] derniers jours viendront des moqueurs avec [leurs] moqueries, marchant selon leurs propres désirs \v 4 et disant : « Où est la promesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue ?
fr.B: Chers amis, voici déjà ma deuxième lettre. Dans l’une et l’autre, je cherche à éveiller votre esprit à une pensée claire en vous rappelant \v 2 les paroles que les saints prophètes ont dites autrefois, et le commandement du Seigneur et Sauveur que vos apôtres vous ont transmis. \v 3 Avant tout, comprenez ceci : dans les derniers jours viendront des moqueurs pleins de mépris, qui vivront selon leurs propres désirs. \v 4 Ils diront : « Où est donc cette promesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue ?
fr.R: Chers amis, c’est la deuxième lettre que je vous écris. Dans ces deux lettres, je veux réveiller votre esprit et vous aider à penser clairement en vous rappelant ce que vous savez déjà. \v 2 Souvenez-vous des paroles que les saints prophètes de Dieu ont dites il y a longtemps. Souvenez-vous aussi du commandement que le Seigneur et Sauveur vous a donné par vos apôtres. \v 3 Surtout, vous devez savoir ceci : dans les derniers jours, des gens viendront qui rient et se moquent. Ils vivront seulement pour se faire plaisir. \v 4 Ils diront : « Jésus a promis de revenir. Qu’est-il arrivé à cette promesse ?

ko.L: 사랑하는 여러분, 이것은 이제 내가 여러분에게 쓰는 두 번째 편지입니다. 나는 이 [두 편지]로 여러분에게 일깨워서 여러분의 순수한 생각을 깨우고 있습니다. \v 2 거룩한 예언자들이 미리 한 말씀과, 여러분의 사도들을 통하여 [받은] 주님이시며 구주이신 분의 계명을 기억하게 하려는 것입니다. \v 3 먼저 이것을 아십시오. 마지막 날들에 조롱하는 사람들이 와서 자기들의 욕망대로 살며 조롱하고, \v 4 "그분이 오신다는 약속은 어디에 있느냐?
ko.B: 사랑하는 여러분, 이것은 내가 여러분에게 쓰는 두 번째 편지입니다. 나는 두 편지 모두에서 여러분에게 일깨워 주어 여러분의 생각을 맑게 깨우려고 합니다. \v 2 거룩한 예언자들이 오래전에 한 말씀과, 주님이시며 구주이신 분께서 여러분의 사도들을 통해 주신 계명을 기억하라는 것입니다. \v 3 무엇보다 먼저 이것을 알아야 합니다. 마지막 날들에 비웃는 사람들이 나타나서, 자기들의 욕망대로 살며 비웃을 것입니다. \v 4 그들은 이렇게 말할 것입니다. "그분이 오신다는 그 약속은 어떻게 되었느냐?
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 이것은 내가 여러분에게 쓰는 두 번째 편지입니다. 나는 두 편지에서 모두 여러분이 이미 아는 것을 일깨워 주어, 여러분의 마음을 깨우고 바르게 생각하도록 돕고 싶습니다. \v 2 하나님의 거룩한 예언자들이 오래전에 한 말씀을 기억하십시오. 또 주님이시며 구주이신 분께서 여러분의 사도들을 통해 주신 계명도 기억하십시오. \v 3 무엇보다 이것을 알아야 합니다. 마지막 날들에 사람들이 나타나서 비웃고 빈정댈 것입니다. 그들은 자기만 좋으면 그만이라고 생각하며 살 것입니다. \v 4 그들은 이렇게 말할 것입니다. "예수가 다시 온다고 약속했다는데, 그 약속은 어떻게 되었느냐?

decisions.choice: second letter: this is the second letter the writer has sent these readers, and the reminder runs through both
alternatives: the second part of one letter
decisions.reason: The relative αἷς is plural, so "in which" means both letters. The earlier letter is not named. 1 Peter is the earlier letter known under Peter's name, but the text itself does not say so.

decisions.choice: a sincere mind: thinking that is pure and unmixed, not corrupted by false teaching
decisions.reason: εἰλικρινής describes what is clear and unmixed, tested and found pure. Peter sets the readers' clear thinking against the twisted reasoning of the false teachers (chapter 2). The "reminder" picks up 1:12-15, where he says he will keep reminding them.

decisions.choice: the command of the Lord and Savior, which came to you through your apostles
alternatives: the command of your apostles, who speak for the Lord
decisions.reason: The genitives stack up: the command "of your apostles" and "of the Lord and Savior". The command belongs to the Lord; the apostles are the ones who delivered it. "Your apostles" are those who first brought the message to these readers. Prophets and apostles stand together as the two witnesses to trust, as in 1:16-21.

decisions.choice: the Lord and Savior: Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: One article covers both titles, and the letter uses the same pair for Jesus Christ by name in 1:11, 2:20 and 3:18.

decisions.choice: the last days: the time the church is already living in, before the Lord returns
alternatives: only the final years just before the end
decisions.reason: In the New Testament the last days began with Christ's coming and the gift of the Spirit (Acts 2:17; Hebrews 1:2). Peter speaks of scoffers who "will come", and his readers are expected to meet them; in chapter 2 the false teachers are already among them.

decisions.choice: scoffers with scoffing: the repetition stresses their mocking
decisions.reason: ἐμπαιγμονῇ and ἐμπαῖκται come from the same root, a way of giving emphasis. Their mockery is aimed at the promise that the Lord will return.

decisions.choice: his coming: the promised return of the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: παρουσία means arrival or presence; Peter has used it for the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ in 1:16. "His" refers back to the Lord and Savior of verse 2. The scoffers' question runs on into the next sentence.

decisions.choice: Dear friends
decisions.reason: ἀγαπητοί means "loved ones", people dear to the writer (and to God). Literal keeps "beloved"; Balanced and Readable say "dear friends", the everyday way to address people one loves. The same choice holds through the chapter (3:8, 3:14, 3:17).

decisions.choice: people who laugh and sneer; "Jesus promised to come back. What happened to that promise?"
alternatives: "Where is the promise of his coming?"
decisions.reason: Readable explains "scoffers" with plain words and turns the question into two short sentences, naming Jesus as the one whose coming was promised (m7).

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Peter writes to his readers in the plural throughout the letter. As in Paul's letters, each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain).

decisions.choice: amados (L); queridos (B); queridos amigos (R)
decisions.reason: ἀγαπητοί is "loved ones". Literal keeps "amados"; Balanced uses "queridos", the ordinary way to address people one loves, as in Philippians 4:1; Readable says "queridos amigos" as the English does. "Hermanos" is not in the Greek here, so it is not added. The same choice holds in 3:8, 3:14 and 3:17.

decisions.choice: wapendwa (L, B); wapendwa wangu (R)
decisions.reason: ἀγαπητοί is "loved ones". "Wapendwa" (those who are loved) says exactly that and is the usual address in letters and sermons; "wapenzi" today often means sweethearts. Readable adds "wangu" (my) for warmth, as the English says "dear friends". The same choice holds in 3:8, 3:14 and 3:17.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives (kwake, yeye, wake)
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns for God and Christ inside the verb ("alichoahidi", "awakute"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, as in Romans. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than the English in this chapter.

decisions.choice: passé composé, bien-aimés (L) / chers amis (B, R), and the deity_pronoun and christos spans as set out in 1:1 (for this chapter)
decisions.reason: The chapter continues the letter’s address to the readers, so the choices made in chapter 1 and in 1 Peter hold here.

decisions.choice: des moqueurs avec [leurs] moqueries (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek repeats the root for emphasis (meaning decision m6); French keeps the repetition at Literal with "moqueurs ... moqueries". Balanced says "pleins de mépris".

decisions.choice: the scoffers speak in 해라체 ("어디에 있느냐?") and without the honorific for Jesus at Readable ("예수가")
decisions.reason: The scoffers mock the promise (meaning decision), so their words are in the plain style of a taunt; at Readable, where the English Readable names Jesus, they name him without the honorific, as unbelievers who mock. At Literal and Balanced "그분이 오신다는" keeps the Greek "his" and is the scoffers' own sarcastic reference.

decisions.choice: "조롱하는 사람들이 ... 조롱하고" (L); "비웃는 사람들이 ... 비웃을" (B); "비웃고 빈정댈" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek repeats the word (meaning decision: the repetition stresses their mocking). Korean repeats it too; "기롱" is archaic.

source.text: ἀφ’ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν, πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως.

records.literal_gloss: From which for the fathers fell asleep, all things thus continue from beginning of creation.

en.L: For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as [they were] from [the] beginning of creation."
en.B: For ever since our ancestors died, everything goes on just as it has from the beginning of creation."
en.R: Our ancestors died long ago, and still everything goes on the same way it has since the world was created."

es.L: Porque desde que los padres durmieron, todas las cosas continúan así desde [el] principio de [la] creación».
es.B: Pues desde que murieron nuestros antepasados, todo sigue igual que desde el principio de la creación».
es.R: Nuestros antepasados murieron hace mucho, y todo sigue igual que desde que el mundo fue creado».

sw.L: Kwa maana tangu mababa walipolala [usingizi], vitu vyote vinaendelea hivi hivi tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji."
sw.B: Kwa maana tangu mababu zetu walipokufa, kila kitu kinaendelea kama kilivyokuwa tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji."
sw.R: Mababu zetu walikufa zamani, na bado kila kitu kinaendelea vilevile tangu ulimwengu ulipoumbwa."

fr.L: Car depuis que les pères se sont endormis, toutes choses demeurent ainsi depuis [le] commencement de [la] création. »
fr.B: Car depuis que nos ancêtres sont morts, tout continue comme depuis le commencement de la création. »
fr.R: Nos ancêtres sont morts il y a longtemps, et pourtant tout continue de la même manière depuis que le monde a été créé. »

ko.L: 조상들이 잠든 뒤로 모든 것이 창조의 처음부터 [있던] 그대로 계속되고 있다" 하고 말할 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리 조상들이 죽은 뒤로도 모든 것이 창조 때부터 있던 그대로 이어지고 있지 않으냐?"
ko.R: 우리 조상들은 오래전에 다 죽었는데, 모든 것이 세상이 처음 만들어질 때와 똑같이 그대로 돌아가고 있지 않으냐?"

decisions.choice: the fathers: the ancestors of Israel, the patriarchs and those who came after them
alternatives: the first generation of Christians, who had died before the Lord returned
decisions.reason: In the New Testament "the fathers" almost always means the ancestors of Israel (Acts 3:13; Romans 9:5; Hebrews 1:1). The scoffers' argument reaches back to the beginning of creation, which fits that sense. But the complaint is about a promise made by Jesus, so they may mean the first believers who died waiting for him. The words allow both.

decisions.choice: fell asleep: died
decisions.reason: ἐκοιμήθησαν is the common New Testament way of speaking of death, especially the death of God's people (John 11:11-13; 1 Thessalonians 4:13-15).

decisions.choice: the scoffers' argument: nothing has changed since creation, so nothing will change
decisions.reason: διαμένει is present: all things "continue" unchanged. The mockers reason that a world that has never been interrupted never will be. Verses 5-7 answer them: the world has been interrupted before, by the flood.

decisions.choice: our ancestors died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of both expressions (m1, m2) in plain words. "Our" is implied: the speakers count the ancestors as their own.

decisions.choice: "잠든" (L); "죽은" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Fell asleep" means died (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture, and Balanced and Readable say what it means, as in the English.

source.text: λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ δι’ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγῳ, δι’ ὧν ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο·

records.literal_gloss: Escapes for them this willing, that heavens were long ago and earth out of water and through water having been formed by the of the God word, \v 6 through which the then world by water having been flooded perished.

en.L: For this escapes [their notice], willingly, that heavens existed long ago and an earth formed out of water and through water by the word of God, \v 6 through which the world of that time, flooded with water, perished.
en.B: They choose to overlook this: long ago, by the word of God, the heavens came into being, and the earth was formed out of water and by means of water. \v 6 By these, water and word, the world of that time was flooded and destroyed.
en.R: But they choose to forget something. Long ago God spoke, and the heavens and the earth came to be. He made the earth rise up out of the water, and water gave it its shape. \v 6 Then God used water and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word to flood the world of that time, and it was destroyed.

es.L: Porque esto se les escapa, queriéndolo [ellos]: que hubo cielos desde antiguo, y una tierra formada de agua y por medio de agua por la palabra de Dios, \v 6 por medio de las cuales el mundo de entonces, inundado de agua, pereció.
es.B: Ellos prefieren pasar por alto esto: hace mucho tiempo, por la palabra de Dios, llegaron a existir los cielos, y la tierra fue formada a partir del agua y por medio del agua. \v 6 Por estas dos cosas, el agua y la palabra, el mundo de aquel tiempo fue inundado y destruido.
es.R: Pero ellos prefieren olvidar algo. Hace mucho tiempo Dios habló, y los cielos y la tierra llegaron a existir. Hizo que la tierra surgiera del agua, y el agua le dio su forma. \v 6 Después Dios usó el agua y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra para inundar el mundo de aquel tiempo, y ese mundo fue destruido.

sw.L: Kwa maana hili linawapita, wakitaka [iwe hivyo], kwamba mbingu zilikuwepo tangu zamani, na dunia iliyoundwa kutoka katika maji na kupitia maji kwa neno la Mungu; \v 6 kupitia hayo ulimwengu wa wakati ule, ukiwa umefunikwa na gharika ya maji, uliangamia.
sw.B: Wanachagua kupuuza jambo hili: zamani, kwa neno la Mungu, mbingu zilianza kuwepo, na dunia iliundwa kutoka katika maji na kwa njia ya maji. \v 6 Kwa hayo mawili, maji na neno, ulimwengu wa wakati ule ulifunikwa na gharika, ukaangamizwa.
sw.R: Lakini wanachagua kusahau jambo moja. Zamani sana Mungu alisema, na mbingu na dunia zikawepo. Aliifanya dunia itokee kutoka katika maji, na maji yakaipa umbo lake. \v 6 Kisha Mungu alitumia maji na neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kuufunika ulimwengu wa wakati ule kwa gharika, nao ukaangamizwa.

fr.L: Car ceci leur échappe, volontairement : des cieux existaient depuis longtemps, et une terre formée à partir de l’eau et au moyen de l’eau par la parole de Dieu, \v 6 par lesquelles le monde d’alors, submergé par l’eau, a péri.
fr.B: Ils veulent ignorer ceci : il y a longtemps, par la parole de Dieu, les cieux ont existé, et la terre a été formée à partir de l’eau et au moyen de l’eau. \v 6 Par ces deux moyens, l’eau et la parole, le monde d’alors a été submergé et détruit.
fr.R: Mais ils choisissent d’oublier une chose. Il y a longtemps, Dieu a parlé, et le ciel et la terre ont existé. Il a fait sortir la terre de l’eau, et c’est l’eau qui lui a donné sa forme. \v 6 Ensuite, Dieu a utilisé l’eau et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole pour inonder le monde de ce temps-là, et ce monde a été détruit.

ko.L: 그들은 일부러 이것을 잊으려고 합니다. 곧 오래전에 하나님의 말씀으로 하늘들이 있었고, 땅이 물에서 나와 물로 말미암아 이루어졌다는 것입니다. \v 6 그것들로 말미암아 그때의 세상은 물에 잠겨 멸망하였습니다.
ko.B: 그들은 이것을 일부러 외면합니다. 오래전에 하나님의 말씀으로 하늘들이 생겨났고, 땅은 물에서 나와 물로 이루어졌습니다. \v 6 바로 그 물과 말씀으로 그때의 세상은 홍수에 잠겨 멸망했습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들은 일부러 어떤 사실을 잊으려고 합니다. 오래전에 하나님께서 말씀하시자 하늘과 땅이 생겨났습니다. 하나님께서는 땅이 물에서 솟아오르게 하셨고, 물로 땅의 모양을 만드셨습니다. \v 6 그리고 하나님께서는 물과 그분의 말씀으로 그때의 세상을 홍수로 덮으셨고, 세상은 멸망했습니다.

decisions.choice: they deliberately overlook it: they want to forget
alternatives: this escapes them, as they hold to their view
decisions.reason: θέλοντας can mean "willingly" (they ignore it on purpose) or "maintaining this" (it escapes them while they insist on their view). Both make the same charge: their ignorance is their own choice. λανθάνει "escapes" is echoed in 3:8, where the readers are told not to let something escape them.

decisions.choice: the creation account: the earth rose out of the waters and was set apart by them at God's word
decisions.reason: Genesis 1 begins with the earth under water; God speaks, the waters are divided, and dry land appears (Genesis 1:2, 1:6-10). "By the word of God" is the repeated "God said" of that chapter (compare Psalm 33:6; Hebrews 11:3).

decisions.choice: through which: through water and the word of God together
alternatives: through the heavens and the earth
decisions.reason: ὧν is plural. It most likely gathers up both things just named: the world was destroyed by water, at God's word. Some take it as the waters, from which the land was made and by which it was flooded, or as the heavens and earth. The point is the same: what God made, God can also judge.

decisions.choice: the flood of Noah's day
decisions.reason: The world was "flooded with water" in the time of Noah (Genesis 7:11-23), as Peter has said in 2:5. ἀπώλετο means it perished or was destroyed, not that the earth ceased to exist: the world as it then was came to an end.

decisions.choice: world: the ordered world with the people living in it
decisions.reason: κόσμος here is the world of that time, the inhabited earth and its people, as in 2:5, "the world of the ungodly".

decisions.choice: they choose to overlook; they choose to forget
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "escapes"; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1). Balanced uses "overlook" again in 3:8 to keep the echo.

decisions.choice: By these, water and word; God used water and his word
decisions.reason: The plural "which" is spelled out, following m3. Readable names God as the one who acted, and rephrases the passive verbs as actions.

decisions.choice: gharika ("ukiwa umefunikwa na gharika ya maji"; "ulifunikwa na gharika")
decisions.reason: κατακλυσθεὶς is "flooded", and the meaning decision ties it to Noah's flood. "Gharika" is the Swahili word for that flood, so it names the event the reader knows from Genesis; "mafuriko" is any ordinary flood.

decisions.choice: par lesquelles (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "through which" as water and the word of God together (m3). Both French nouns are feminine, so the feminine plural "lesquelles" covers both, as the Greek plural does.

source.text: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.

records.literal_gloss: The but now heavens and the earth by the same word having been stored up are for fire being kept for day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly people.

en.L: But the present heavens and the earth by the same word have been stored up for fire, being kept for [the] day of judgment and destruction of the {{gender:ungodly people|ungodly men}}.
en.B: But by that same word the present heavens and earth are being held in store for fire. They are kept for the day when {{gender:ungodly people|ungodly men}} will be judged and destroyed.
en.R: And by that same word, the heavens and the earth we see now are being kept for fire. God is keeping them for the day when {{gender:people|men}} who do not honor God will be judged and destroyed.

es.L: Pero los cielos y la tierra de ahora, por la misma palabra, están guardados en reserva para [el] fuego, conservados para [el] día del juicio y de la destrucción de {{gender:las personas impías|los hombres impíos}}.
es.B: Pero por esa misma palabra, los cielos y la tierra que hay ahora están reservados para el fuego. Se los guarda para el día en que se juzgará y se destruirá a {{gender:las personas impías|los hombres impíos}}.
es.R: Y por esa misma palabra, los cielos y la tierra que vemos ahora están guardados para el fuego. Dios los está guardando para el día en que juzgará y destruirá a {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} que no honran a Dios.

sw.L: Lakini mbingu na dunia zilizopo sasa, kwa neno hilo hilo, zimewekwa [kama] hazina kwa ajili ya moto, zikilindwa kwa ajili ya siku ya hukumu na ya maangamizi ya watu wasiomcha Mungu.
sw.B: Lakini kwa neno hilo hilo, mbingu na dunia za sasa zinahifadhiwa kwa ajili ya moto. Zinalindwa hadi siku ambayo watu wasiomcha Mungu watahukumiwa na kuangamizwa.
sw.R: Na kwa neno hilo hilo, mbingu na dunia tunazoziona sasa zinatunzwa kwa ajili ya moto. Mungu anazitunza hadi siku ambayo watu wasiomheshimu Mungu watahukumiwa na kuangamizwa.

fr.L: Mais les cieux et la terre d’à présent, par la même parole, sont mis en réserve pour le feu, gardés pour [le] jour du jugement et de la destruction des {{gender:gens impies|hommes impies}}.
fr.B: Mais par cette même parole, les cieux et la terre d’aujourd’hui sont tenus en réserve pour le feu. Ils sont gardés pour le jour où {{gender:les gens impies|les hommes impies}} seront jugés et détruits.
fr.R: Et par cette même parole, le ciel et la terre que nous voyons maintenant sont gardés pour le feu. Dieu les garde pour le jour où {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} qui n’honorent pas Dieu seront jugés et détruits.

ko.L: 그러나 지금의 하늘들과 땅은 같은 말씀으로 불에 태우려고 간직되어 있으며, 경건하지 않은 사람들이 심판을 받고 멸망할 날까지 보존되고 있습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 지금 있는 하늘들과 땅은 바로 그 말씀으로 불에 타도록 보존되고 있습니다. 경건하지 않은 사람들이 심판을 받고 멸망할 날까지 보존되는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그리고 지금 우리가 보는 하늘과 땅도 바로 그 말씀으로 불에 타게 될 날을 위해 남겨져 있습니다. 하나님께서는 하나님을 공경하지 않는 사람들이 심판을 받고 멸망할 날을 위해 그것들을 남겨 두고 계십니다.

decisions.choice: by the same word: the word of God that made the world and flooded it
decisions.reason: αὐτῷ "same" points back to "the word of God" in verse 5. The world now stands only because God's word holds it, and that word has set its end.

decisions.choice: stored up for fire: kept in reserve to be judged by fire
alternatives: stored up with fire, holding fire within them
decisions.reason: πυρὶ is most naturally "for fire", the end the world is kept for, as the flood was the end of the first world. Fire is the Old Testament picture of God's judgment (Isaiah 66:15-16; Malachi 4:1).

decisions.choice: destruction of the ungodly: their ruin at the judgment
decisions.reason: ἀπώλεια is the same word used of the false teachers' end in 2:1-3; it means ruin and loss, the opposite of being saved. ἀσεβής describes people without reverence for God (2:5-6).

decisions.choice: ungodly people (alternative: ungodly men)
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπων means human beings, men and women; the gender setting gives the traditional "men".

decisions.choice: people who do not honor God; God is keeping them
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ungodly" (m3) and names God as the one keeping the world (m1).

decisions.choice: el día en que se juzgará y se destruirá a ...; el día en que juzgará y destruirá a ...
alternatives: el día en que ... serán juzgados y destruidos
decisions.reason: A passive participle would have to agree with "personas" (juzgadas) or "hombres" (juzgados), so it could not sit outside the gender span. Balanced uses the impersonal "se juzgará" and Readable names God as the judge, as the English Readable does, so only the noun phrase changes with the setting.

decisions.choice: watu, no gender span
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπων means human beings, men and women. "Watu" already means that; "wanaume" means males and would change the meaning, so Swahili has no counterpart to the English gender span.

decisions.choice: {{gender:gens impies|hommes impies}} (L); {{gender:les gens impies|les hommes impies}} (B); {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} (R)
decisions.reason: The word means human beings, men and women, as the English span says; "gens" is the inclusive default and "hommes" the traditional alternative, with the adjective the same after both.

decisions.choice: "경건하지 않은 사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "people" or "men" for a word meaning human beings; Korean "사람" includes men and women and has no generic masculine, so the setting has nothing to change.

source.text: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς, ἀγαπητοί, ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία.

records.literal_gloss: One but this not let escape you, beloved, that one day with Lord like thousand years and thousand years like day one.

en.L: But do not let this one [thing] escape you, beloved: that one day with [the] Lord [is] like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
en.B: But you, dear friends, must not overlook this one thing: in the Lord's sight a single day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like a single day.
en.R: Dear friends, there is one thing you must keep in mind. To the Lord, a single day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a single day.

es.L: Pero que esta sola [cosa] no se {{plural_you:les|os}} escape, amados: que un día ante [el] Señor [es] como mil años, y mil años como un día.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, queridos, no {{plural_you:pasen|paséis}} por alto esto: a los ojos del Señor un solo día es como mil años, y mil años como un solo día.
es.R: Queridos amigos, hay algo que no {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} olvidar. Para el Señor, un solo día es como mil años, y mil años son como un solo día.

sw.L: Lakini jambo hili moja lisiwapite, wapendwa, kwamba siku moja kwa Bwana [ni] kama miaka elfu, na miaka elfu kama siku moja.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi, wapendwa, msilipuuze jambo hili moja: machoni pa Bwana siku moja ni sawa na miaka elfu, na miaka elfu ni sawa na siku moja.
sw.R: Wapendwa wangu, kuna jambo moja ambalo lazima mlikumbuke. Kwa Bwana, siku moja ni kama miaka elfu, na miaka elfu ni kama siku moja.

fr.L: Mais que cette seule [chose] ne vous échappe pas, bien-aimés : un seul jour auprès du Seigneur [est] comme mille ans, et mille ans comme un seul jour.
fr.B: Mais vous, chers amis, ne perdez pas de vue cette seule chose : aux yeux du Seigneur, un jour est comme mille ans, et mille ans sont comme un jour.
fr.R: Chers amis, il y a une chose que vous devez garder à l’esprit. Pour le Seigneur, un seul jour est comme mille ans, et mille ans sont comme un seul jour.

ko.L: 그러나 사랑하는 여러분, 이 한 가지를 잊지 마십시오. 주님께는 하루가 천 년 같고, 천 년이 하루 같습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 사랑하는 여러분, 이 한 가지만은 놓치지 마십시오. 주님께서 보시기에는 하루가 천 년과 같고, 천 년이 하루와 같습니다.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 꼭 기억해야 할 것이 한 가지 있습니다. 주님께는 하루가 천 년과 같고, 천 년이 하루와 같습니다.

decisions.choice: Psalm 90:4: a thousand years in God's sight are like a day that has passed
decisions.reason: The psalm, a prayer of Moses, contrasts God's eternity with the shortness of human life (Psalm 90:4; 89:4 in the Greek Old Testament). Peter turns the saying both ways: time does not limit God, and he does not measure delay as people do. The Lord here is God, as in the psalm.

decisions.choice: do not let this escape you: the readers must not do what the scoffers did
decisions.reason: λανθανέτω repeats the verb of verse 5: the scoffers let a fact escape them; the readers must not.

decisions.choice: God is not bound by time; the saying is not a formula for dating the end
alternatives: a key that turns each day of creation into a thousand years of history
decisions.reason: Peter answers the charge that the Lord is slow (3:9). He is speaking of how God sees time, not giving a scale for counting it.

source.text: οὐ βραδύνει κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται, ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ὑμᾶς, μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι.

records.literal_gloss: Not is slow Lord of the promise, as some slowness consider, but is patient toward you, not wanting some to perish but all to repentance to come.

en.L: [The] Lord is not slow about the promise, as some reckon slowness, but is patient toward you, not willing for any to perish, but for all to make their way to repentance.
en.B: The Lord is not delaying the promise, as some people think of delay. Rather, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is being patient with you. He does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants all people to turn back in repentance.
en.R: The Lord is not slow to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised, though some people think {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. He is being patient with you. He does not want anyone to be destroyed. He wants everyone to turn away from their sins and come back to God.

es.L: [El] Señor no tarda [en cumplir] la promesa, según algunos consideran tardanza, sino que es paciente con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, no queriendo que nadie perezca, sino que todos avancen hacia [el] arrepentimiento.
es.B: El Señor no está retrasando la promesa, como algunos entienden el retraso. Más bien, está teniendo paciencia con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No quiere que nadie sea destruido, sino que todos lleguen a arrepentirse.
es.R: El Señor no tarda en cumplir lo que prometió, aunque algunos piensan que sí. Está teniendo paciencia con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No quiere que nadie sea destruido. Quiere que todos dejen sus pecados y vuelvan a Dios.

sw.L: Bwana hachelewi [kutimiza] ahadi, kama wengine wanavyodhani ni kuchelewa, bali ni mvumilivu kwenu, hataki yeyote aangamie, bali wote wafike kwenye toba.
sw.B: Bwana hachelewi kutimiza ahadi, kama watu wengine wanavyoelewa kuchelewa. Badala yake, anawavumilia ninyi. Hataki mtu yeyote aangamizwe, bali anataka watu wote wageuke na kutubu.
sw.R: Bwana hachelewi kufanya kile alichoahidi, ingawa watu wengine wanadhani anachelewa. Anawavumilia ninyi. Hataki mtu yeyote aangamizwe. Anataka kila mtu aache dhambi zake na kumrudia Mungu.

fr.L: [Le] Seigneur ne tarde pas [à accomplir] la promesse, comme certains estiment qu’il y a du retard, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} use de patience envers vous, ne voulant pas que certains périssent, mais que tous parviennent à [la] repentance.
fr.B: Le Seigneur ne retarde pas l’accomplissement de la promesse, comme certains pensent qu’il y a du retard. Au contraire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait preuve de patience envers vous. Il ne veut la destruction de personne, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut que tous parviennent à la repentance.
fr.R: Le Seigneur ne tarde pas à faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promis, même si certains pensent qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tarde. Il est patient avec vous. Il ne veut pas que quelqu’un soit détruit. Il veut que tout le monde se détourne de ses péchés et revienne à Dieu.

ko.L: 주님께서는 어떤 사람들이 더디다고 여기는 것처럼 약속을 더디 지키시는 것이 아닙니다. 오히려 여러분을 위하여 오래 참으시는 것입니다. 아무도 멸망하지 않고 모두 회개에 이르기를 원하시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 어떤 사람들은 주님께서 약속을 미루신다고 생각하지만, 주님께서는 약속을 미루시는 것이 아닙니다. 오히려 여러분을 위해 오래 참고 계신 것입니다. 주님께서는 아무도 멸망하지 않고 모든 사람이 회개하여 돌아오기를 원하십니다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 주님께서 약속하신 일을 늦게 하신다고 생각하지만, 주님께서는 늦으신 것이 아닙니다. 주님께서는 여러분을 위해 오래 참고 계십니다. 주님께서는 아무도 멸망하지 않기를 원하십니다. 모든 사람이 죄에서 돌아서서 하나님께 돌아오기를 원하십니다.

decisions.choice: not slow: the Lord is not late in keeping the promise
decisions.reason: βραδύνω means to be slow or to delay. The scoffers read the long wait as failure (3:4); Peter answers that what looks like delay has another cause.

decisions.choice: patient: holding back judgment to give time
decisions.reason: μακροθυμέω is patience that bears with wrongdoing and waits instead of acting at once, as God waited in the days of Noah (1 Peter 3:20). Verse 15 calls this patience salvation.

decisions.choice: God does not want anyone to perish; he wants all people to come to repentance
alternatives: all of you, the readers, to come to repentance
decisions.reason: πάντας "all" stands against "any". Coming right after "toward you", it could mean all the readers, but the contrast with perishing is general, and Scripture says the same of God's will for everyone (Ezekiel 18:23, 18:32; 1 Timothy 2:4). The sentence states what God wants, not what every person will do.

decisions.choice: perish: be destroyed at the judgment
decisions.reason: ἀπολέσθαι is from the same root as "perished" (3:6) and "destruction" (3:7): to be lost in the judgment God has set.

decisions.choice: be destroyed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "destroyed" to keep the link with "destroyed" in 3:6-7 (m4). Literal keeps "perish".

decisions.choice: turn away from their sins and come back to God
decisions.reason: Readable explains repentance: a change of mind and life, turning from sin to God.

decisions.choice: la repentance (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Repentance" says the turning away from sin that the word means; "conversion" today often suggests changing religion. Readable says it in plain words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "오래 참으시다" for patience; "회개" (L, B); "죄에서 돌아서다" (R)
decisions.reason: The patience is God holding back judgment to give time (meaning decision); "오래 참다" is the word used of God's patience in 1 Peter 3:20. "회개" is the established word for repentance; Readable says what it is.

source.text: ἥξει δὲ ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης, ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται, στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα λυθήσεται, καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: Will come but day of Lord like thief, in which the heavens with a rushing noise will pass away, elements and burning will be dissolved, and earth and the in it works will be found.

en.L: But [the] day of [the] Lord will come like a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a rushing noise, and [the] elements, burning, will be dissolved, and [the] earth and the works in it will be found.
en.B: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. On that day the heavens will vanish with a rushing sound, the elements will be set ablaze and break apart, and the earth and the deeds done on it will be found out.
en.R: But the day of the Lord will come suddenly, like a thief. On that day the heavens will disappear with a loud rushing noise. The elements that make up the world will burn and fall apart. The earth and everything people have done on it will be brought out into the open.

es.L: Pero vendrá [el] día del Señor como un ladrón, en el cual los cielos pasarán con estrépito, y [los] elementos, ardiendo, serán disueltos, y [la] tierra y las obras [que hay] en ella serán halladas.
es.B: Pero el día del Señor vendrá como un ladrón. Ese día los cielos desaparecerán con un estruendo, los elementos arderán y se desintegrarán, y la tierra y las obras hechas en ella quedarán al descubierto.
es.R: Pero el día del Señor vendrá de repente, como un ladrón. Ese día los cielos desaparecerán con un fuerte ruido. Los elementos de los que está hecho el mundo arderán y se desharán. La tierra y todo lo que la gente ha hecho en ella quedará a la vista.

sw.L: Lakini siku ya Bwana itakuja kama mwizi; katika [siku] hiyo mbingu zitapita kwa mvumo, na vitu vya msingi vikiungua vitasambaratishwa, na dunia na kazi zilizo ndani yake zitaonekana.
sw.B: Lakini siku ya Bwana itakuja kama mwizi. Siku hiyo mbingu zitapita kwa mvumo mkubwa, vitu vya msingi vitawaka moto na kusambaratika, na dunia pamoja na matendo yaliyofanywa juu yake yataonekana wazi.
sw.R: Lakini siku ya Bwana itakuja ghafla, kama mwizi. Siku hiyo mbingu zitatoweka kwa mvumo mkubwa. Vitu vyote ambavyo ulimwengu umeundwa navyo vitaungua na kusambaratika. Dunia na kila kitu ambacho watu wamefanya juu yake vitawekwa wazi.

fr.L: Mais [le] jour du Seigneur viendra comme un voleur ; en ce [jour] les cieux passeront avec fracas, [les] éléments embrasés seront dissous, et [la] terre et les œuvres qui sont en elle seront trouvées.
fr.B: Mais le jour du Seigneur viendra comme un voleur. Ce jour-là, les cieux disparaîtront dans un grand fracas, les éléments s’embraseront et se désagrégeront, et la terre et les œuvres qui s’y font seront mises au jour.
fr.R: Mais le jour du Seigneur viendra soudainement, comme un voleur. Ce jour-là, le ciel disparaîtra dans un grand bruit de tempête. Les éléments qui forment le monde brûleront et se désagrégeront. La terre et tout ce que les gens y ont fait seront exposés en pleine lumière.

ko.L: 그러나 주님의 날이 도둑같이 올 것입니다. 그날에 하늘들은 굉음을 내며 사라지고, 원소들은 불타서 풀어지고, 땅과 그 안에 있는 일들이 드러날 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님의 날은 도둑처럼 올 것입니다. 그날에 하늘들은 요란한 소리를 내며 사라지고, 원소들은 불에 타서 녹아 없어지며, 땅과 땅 위에서 한 일들이 모두 드러날 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님의 날은 도둑처럼 갑자기 올 것입니다. 그날에 하늘은 크게 울리는 소리를 내며 사라질 것입니다. 세상을 이루는 모든 것이 불에 타서 녹아 버릴 것입니다. 땅과 사람들이 그 위에서 한 모든 일이 환히 드러날 것입니다.

decisions.choice: the day of the Lord will come like a thief: suddenly, when no one expects it
decisions.reason: "The day of the Lord" is the Old Testament name for the day God acts in judgment (Joel 2:31; Amos 5:18; Zephaniah 1:14). "Like a thief" is Jesus' own picture of his unexpected return (Matthew 24:43; Luke 12:39), repeated in 1 Thessalonians 5:2 and Revelation 3:3.

decisions.choice: with a rushing noise: a roar, the sound of something rushing past or consumed by fire
decisions.reason: ῥοιζηδόν describes a whizzing, crackling or roaring sound. It is found only here in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: elements: the basic parts the world is made of
alternatives: the heavenly bodies, sun, moon and stars
decisions.reason: στοιχεῖον means the basic parts of something. Here it stands between the heavens and the earth, so it may mean the stuff of the universe or the heavenly bodies, which Isaiah 34:4 says will dissolve. Paul uses the word for the basic principles of this world (Galatians 4:3), but that sense does not fit "burning".

decisions.choice: will be found: the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: The manuscripts differ at the end of this verse. From general knowledge: "will be found" is the reading of the oldest Greek manuscripts, including Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, and a papyrus (P72) has "will be found dissolved". "Will be burned up" is in Codex Alexandrinus and most later manuscripts, and became the familiar reading. Some early versions read "will not be found", and Codex Ephraemi reads "will disappear". "Will be found" is the hardest reading, and copyists seem to have changed it to something easier. The SBLGNT text is followed here. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus before the sentence is marked meaning reviewed.

decisions.choice: will be found: laid open before God for judgment, with nothing hidden
alternatives: found to remain, surviving the fire
decisions.reason: With the heavens gone and the elements dissolved, the earth and what was done on it stand exposed to God. εὑρίσκω is used this way in 3:14, where the readers are to be "found" spotless by him; compare 1 Corinthians 3:13, where fire shows what each person's work is.

decisions.choice: works: the deeds people have done on the earth
alternatives: the things made on the earth
decisions.reason: ἔργον can mean deeds or things made. Read with "will be found" (m5), it most likely means human deeds brought to judgment, but it may mean everything on the earth.

decisions.choice: suddenly, like a thief
decisions.reason: Readable adds "suddenly" so the picture is clear (m1).

decisions.choice: will be found out; will be brought out into the open
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "found" to stay close to the Greek and to echo 3:14, adding "out" to show the sense of exposure (m5). Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: quedarán al descubierto
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "serán halladas", which echoes "ser hallados" in 3:14. On its own the Spanish passive "serán halladas" sounds unfinished (found where? found how?), so Balanced gives the sense of exposure the meaning decision describes (m5), as the English "found out" does.

decisions.choice: vitu vya msingi (L, B); vitu vyote ambavyo ulimwengu umeundwa navyo (R)
decisions.reason: στοιχεῖα are the basic parts the world is made of (m3). "Vitu vya msingi" (basic things) says that in plain words; "elementi" is a chemistry term, and "viumbe" would suggest living creatures. Readable spells it out, as the English does. The same words are used in 3:12.

decisions.choice: "원소들" (L, B); "세상을 이루는 모든 것" (R); "드러날 것입니다" for "will be found"
decisions.reason: The elements are the basic parts the world is made of (meaning decision, footnoted). The meaning decision follows the SBLGNT "will be found", read as laid open before God for judgment, and footnotes the reading "burned up"; "드러나다" says that.

source.text: Τούτων οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις, προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέρας, δι’ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται·

records.literal_gloss: These thus all being dissolved, what sort ought to be you in holy conducts and godlinesses, \v 12 awaiting and hastening the coming of the of the God day, because of which heavens being set on fire will be dissolved and elements burning melt.

en.L: Since all these things are being dissolved in this way, what sort [of people] you ought to be in holy conduct and godliness, \v 12 waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which [the] heavens, set on fire, will be dissolved, and [the] elements, burning, melt!
en.B: Since everything is to be dissolved in this way, think what sort of people you ought to be! Live holy and godly lives, \v 12 as you wait for the coming of the day of God and hurry it on. That day will set the heavens on fire and dissolve them, and the elements will melt in the heat.
en.R: All these things will be destroyed like this. So think about what kind of people you should be! Live holy lives that honor God, \v 12 as you wait for the day of God. Live in a way that makes that day come sooner. On that day the heavens will catch fire and be destroyed, and everything the world is made of will melt in the heat.

es.L: Ya que todas estas cosas se disuelven de este modo, ¡qué clase [de personas] {{plural_you:deben ser ustedes|debéis ser vosotros}} en conducta santa y en piedad, \v 12 esperando y apresurando la venida del día de Dios, a causa del cual [los] cielos, encendidos, serán disueltos, y [los] elementos, ardiendo, se derriten!
es.B: Ya que todo va a disolverse de esta manera, ¡{{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} qué clase de personas {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} ser! {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} vidas santas y piadosas, \v 12 mientras {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}} la venida del día de Dios y {{plural_you:apresuran|apresuráis}} su llegada. Ese día los cielos se encenderán y serán disueltos, y los elementos se derretirán con el calor.
es.R: Todas estas cosas serán destruidas así. Por eso, ¡{{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} qué clase de personas {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} ser! {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} vidas santas que honren a Dios, \v 12 mientras {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}} el día de Dios. {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} de tal manera que ese día llegue más pronto. Ese día los cielos se incendiarán y serán destruidos, y todo aquello de lo que está hecho el mundo se derretirá con el calor.

sw.L: Kwa kuwa vitu hivi vyote vinasambaratishwa hivyo, mnapaswa kuwa watu wa namna gani katika mienendo mitakatifu na utauwa, \v 12 mkingojea na kuharakisha kuja kwa siku ya Mungu, ambayo kwa sababu yake mbingu zikiwaka moto zitasambaratishwa, na vitu vya msingi vikiungua vinayeyuka!
sw.B: Kwa kuwa kila kitu kitasambaratishwa hivi, fikirini mnapaswa kuwa watu wa namna gani! Ishini maisha matakatifu na ya utauwa, \v 12 mkingojea kuja kwa siku ya Mungu na kuiharakisha. Siku hiyo itaziwasha mbingu moto na kuzisambaratisha, na vitu vya msingi vitayeyuka kwa joto kali.
sw.R: Vitu hivi vyote vitaangamizwa namna hii. Kwa hiyo fikirini mnapaswa kuwa watu wa namna gani! Ishini maisha matakatifu yanayomheshimu Mungu, \v 12 mkingojea siku ya Mungu. Ishini kwa namna ambayo itaifanya siku hiyo ije mapema. Siku hiyo mbingu zitashika moto na kuangamizwa, na vitu vyote ambavyo ulimwengu umeundwa navyo vitayeyuka kwa joto kali.

fr.L: Puisque toutes ces choses se dissolvent ainsi, quelle sorte [de personnes] vous devez être dans une conduite sainte et dans la piété, \v 12 attendant et hâtant la venue du jour de Dieu, à cause duquel [les] cieux enflammés seront dissous et [les] éléments embrasés fondront !
fr.B: Puisque tout doit se dissoudre ainsi, pensez à ce que vous devez être ! Menez une vie sainte et pieuse, \v 12 en attendant la venue du jour de Dieu et en hâtant sa venue. Ce jour-là mettra le feu aux cieux et les dissoudra, et les éléments fondront dans la chaleur.
fr.R: Toutes ces choses vont être détruites de cette manière. Alors pensez au genre de personnes que vous devez être ! Vivez une vie sainte qui honore Dieu, \v 12 pendant que vous attendez le jour de Dieu. Vivez de manière à faire venir ce jour plus vite. Ce jour-là, le ciel prendra feu et sera détruit, et tout ce qui forme le monde fondra dans la chaleur.

ko.L: 이 모든 것이 이렇게 풀어질 것이니, 여러분은 거룩한 행실과 경건 가운데 어떠한 사람이 되어야 하겠습니까! \v 12 하나님의 날이 오기를 기다리며 서두르십시오. 그날 때문에 하늘들은 불타서 풀어지고, 원소들은 불에 녹을 것입니다.
ko.B: 이 모든 것이 이렇게 녹아 없어질 것이니, 여러분은 어떤 사람이 되어야 하겠습니까! 거룩하고 경건하게 사십시오. \v 12 하나님의 날이 오기를 기다리고, 그날이 어서 오도록 힘쓰십시오. 그날에 하늘들은 불타서 녹아 없어지고, 원소들은 뜨거운 열에 녹을 것입니다.
ko.R: 이 모든 것이 이렇게 없어질 것입니다. 그러니 여러분이 어떤 사람이 되어야 할지 생각해 보십시오! 거룩하게 살고, 하나님을 공경하는 삶을 사십시오. \v 12 하나님의 날을 기다리며 사십시오. 그날이 더 빨리 오도록 사십시오. 그날에 하늘은 불이 붙어 없어지고, 세상을 이루는 모든 것은 뜨거운 열에 녹아 버릴 것입니다.

decisions.choice: what sort of people you ought to be: an exclamation that calls for a holy life
alternatives: a question: what sort of people ought you to be?
decisions.reason: ποταποὺς can open a question or an exclamation. The SBLGNT does not punctuate it as a question, and the answer follows at once: holy conduct and godliness. Either way it presses the readers to live in the light of the end.

decisions.choice: holy conduct and godliness: holy ways of living and acts of devotion to God
decisions.reason: Both nouns are plural, pointing to many acts and habits of holy living and reverence for God. εὐσέβεια is the godliness of 1:3, 1:6-7, the opposite of the "ungodly" of 3:7.

decisions.choice: hastening: helping to bring the day sooner, by repentance and holy living
decisions.reason: σπεύδω usually means to hurry. With an object it can mean to hurry something on, or to be eager for it. Verse 9 says the Lord waits so that people may repent, and Acts 3:19-21 links repentance with the coming of the times of refreshing; so the readers' lives can speed the day. The other reading takes the word as eager longing, close to "waiting for". This draft follows the first reading.

decisions.choice: the coming of the day of God: the same day as the day of the Lord (3:10)
decisions.reason: "The day of God" is a rare phrase in the New Testament; here it means the day of the Lord just described. παρουσία is the same word as "coming" in 3:4: the scoffers mocked it; the readers wait for it.

decisions.choice: because of which: the day of God brings the dissolving of the heavens and elements
decisions.reason: δι ἣν means "on account of which": the day is the cause. The verb "melt" is present in form, but it describes what will happen then, as the parallel "will be dissolved" shows. The language recalls Isaiah 34:4.

decisions.choice: two sentences: an exclamation, then a command
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the long Greek sentence, turning the description of holy living into a command so it reads clearly (m1).

decisions.choice: Live in a way that makes that day come sooner.
decisions.reason: Readable follows m3 and explains how the day is hastened. It is an expansion on a debated word, so reviewers should weigh it with m3.

decisions.choice: piedad (L); piadosas (B)
decisions.reason: εὐσέβεια is reverence for God lived out. "Piedad" is the settled word for it in Peter's letters, as "impíos" is for the ungodly in 3:7. Readable says what it means, "vidas santas que honren a Dios", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: utauwa
decisions.reason: εὐσέβεια is reverence for God lived out. "Utauwa" is the settled Swahili word for it in Peter's letters, and it stands against "wasiomcha Mungu" (the ungodly) in 3:7. Readable says what it means, "maisha ... yanayomheshimu Mungu", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "서두르십시오" (L); "어서 오도록 힘쓰십시오" (B); "더 빨리 오도록 사십시오" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "hastening" as helping to bring the day sooner by repentance and holy living, and footnotes the reading "eagerly desiring". Korean says the hastening plainly at each level.

source.text: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν, ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ.

records.literal_gloss: New but heavens and earth new according to the promise of him we await, in which righteousness dwells.

en.L: But new heavens and a new earth, according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promise, we are waiting for, in which righteousness dwells.
en.B: But we are looking forward to what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised: new heavens and a new earth, where righteousness is at home.
en.R: But we are waiting for new heavens and a new earth, just as God promised. Righteousness will be at home there.

es.L: Pero cielos nuevos y una tierra nueva, según {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} promesa, esperamos, en los cuales habita [la] justicia.
es.B: Pero nosotros esperamos lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} prometió: cielos nuevos y una tierra nueva, donde la justicia tiene su hogar.
es.R: Pero nosotros esperamos cielos nuevos y una tierra nueva, tal como Dios lo prometió. Allí la justicia tendrá su hogar.

sw.L: Lakini mbingu mpya na dunia mpya, kwa kadiri ya ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, tunazingojea, ambamo haki inakaa.
sw.B: Lakini tunangojea kwa hamu kile alichoahidi: mbingu mpya na dunia mpya, ambamo haki ina makao yake.
sw.R: Lakini tunangojea mbingu mpya na dunia mpya, kama Mungu alivyoahidi. Huko haki itakuwa na makao yake.

fr.L: Mais ce sont de nouveaux cieux et une nouvelle terre, selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} promesse, que nous attendons, dans lesquels la justice habite.
fr.B: Mais nous attendons ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promis : de nouveaux cieux et une nouvelle terre, où la justice est chez elle.
fr.R: Mais nous attendons un nouveau ciel et une nouvelle terre, comme Dieu l’a promis. La justice y sera chez elle.

ko.L: 그러나 우리는 그분의 약속을 따라 새 하늘들과 새 땅을 기다립니다. 그곳에는 의가 머물러 삽니다.
ko.B: 그러나 우리는 그분이 약속하신 새 하늘들과 새 땅을 기다리고 있습니다. 그곳은 의가 자기 집처럼 머무는 곳입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 우리는 하나님께서 약속하신 대로 새 하늘과 새 땅을 기다리고 있습니다. 그곳에서는 의가 영원히 살 것입니다.

decisions.choice: new heavens and a new earth: God's promise in Isaiah
decisions.reason: God says in Isaiah 65:17 and 66:22 that he will create new heavens and a new earth. Revelation 21:1 sees it fulfilled. "His promise" is that promise of God, which the scoffers' talk of "the promise" (3:4) ignores.

decisions.choice: new: made new, a world of a different order
alternatives: merely another world like this one
decisions.reason: καινός speaks of what is new in kind and fresh, not just recent. The fire of judgment ends the present world, but God's purpose is a renewed creation.

decisions.choice: righteousness dwells there: what is right before God will be settled there for good
decisions.reason: κατοικέω means to settle and live in a place as one's home. In the present world the ungodly are at home (3:7); in the new one, righteousness will be.

decisions.choice: just as God promised
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who made the promise (m1).

decisions.choice: "의가 머물러 삽니다" (L); "의가 자기 집처럼 머무는 곳" (B); "의가 영원히 살 것입니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to dwell, to be at home (meaning decision: what is right before God will be settled there for good). Korean keeps the picture of dwelling; "의" is the key term.

source.text: Διό, ἀγαπητοί, ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ, καὶ τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν, ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, beloved, these things awaiting, be diligent spotless and blameless by him to be found in peace, \v 15 and the of the Lord of us patience salvation consider, just as also the beloved of us brother Paul according to the having been given to him wisdom wrote to you, \v 16 as also in all the letters speaking in them about these things, in which are hard to understand some things, which the untaught and unstable twist as also the other writings to the own of them destruction.

en.L: Therefore, beloved, waiting for these things, be diligent to be found by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} spotless and blameless, in peace, \v 15 and consider the patience of our Lord [to be] salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given to him, \v 16 as [he does] also in all [his] letters, speaking in them about these things, in which are some things hard to understand, which the untaught and unstable twist, as [they do] also the other scriptures, to their own destruction.
en.B: So, dear friends, while you wait for these things, work hard to be found by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} spotless and without fault, and at peace. \v 15 Regard our Lord's patience as salvation. Paul, our dear brother, wrote to you about this too, with the wisdom God gave him. \v 16 He does so in all his letters when he speaks of these things. Some things in them are hard to grasp, and people who are untaught and unsteady bend them out of shape, as they bend the other Scriptures, and so bring about their own destruction.
en.R: So, dear friends, while you are waiting for these things, try hard to live pure lives with nothing wrong in them. Then when the Lord comes, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will find you living in peace. \v 15 Remember that our Lord is patient because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants people to be saved. Our dear brother Paul also wrote to you about this, with the wisdom that God gave him. \v 16 He writes about these things in all his letters. Some things in his letters are hard to understand. People who have not been taught well and do not stand firm twist what he wrote to make it mean something else. They do the same with the rest of the Scriptures. In the end it will destroy them.

es.L: Por eso, amados, esperando estas cosas, {{plural_you:empéñense|empeñaos}} en ser hallados por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sin mancha e intachables, en paz, \v 15 y {{plural_you:consideren|considerad}} la paciencia de nuestro Señor [como] salvación, como también nuestro amado hermano Pablo {{plural_you:les|os}} escribió según la sabiduría que le fue dada, \v 16 como [lo hace] también en todas [sus] cartas, hablando en ellas de estas cosas, en las cuales hay algunas cosas difíciles de entender, que los sin instrucción e inestables retuercen, como también las demás Escrituras, para su propia destrucción.
es.B: Así que, queridos, mientras {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}} estas cosas, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} todo lo posible para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} encuentre sin mancha y sin falta, y en paz. \v 15 {{plural_you:Consideren|Considerad}} la paciencia de nuestro Señor como salvación. Pablo, nuestro querido hermano, también {{plural_you:les|os}} escribió sobre esto, con la sabiduría que Dios le dio. \v 16 Lo hace en todas sus cartas cuando habla de estas cosas. Algunas cosas en ellas son difíciles de comprender, y los que no han sido instruidos y no están firmes las deforman, como deforman también las demás Escrituras, y así provocan su propia destrucción.
es.R: Por eso, queridos amigos, mientras {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}} estas cosas, {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} por vivir vidas puras, sin nada malo en ellas. Así, cuando el Señor venga, {{plural_you:los|os}} encontrará viviendo en paz. \v 15 {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} que nuestro Señor es paciente porque quiere que la gente se salve. Nuestro querido hermano Pablo también {{plural_you:les|os}} escribió sobre esto, con la sabiduría que Dios le dio. \v 16 Él escribe sobre estas cosas en todas sus cartas. Algunas cosas de sus cartas son difíciles de entender. Hay personas que no han sido bien enseñadas y no se mantienen firmes, y tuercen lo que él escribió para que signifique otra cosa. Hacen lo mismo con el resto de las Escrituras. Al final, eso las destruirá.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, wapendwa, mkingojea mambo haya, jitahidini kuonekana na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} bila doa na bila lawama, katika amani, \v 15 na mhesabu uvumilivu wa Bwana wetu [kuwa] wokovu, kama vile Paulo, ndugu yetu mpendwa, pia aliwaandikia kwa kufuata hekima iliyotolewa kwake, \v 16 kama [afanyavyo] pia katika barua [zake] zote, akinena ndani yake kuhusu mambo haya; ndani yake mna mambo fulani magumu kueleweka, ambayo wasiofundishwa na wasio thabiti huyapindisha, kama [wafanyavyo] pia Maandiko mengine, kwa maangamizi yao wenyewe.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, wapendwa, mnapoyangojea mambo haya, fanyeni juhudi ili {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} awakute bila doa wala kasoro, mkiwa na amani. \v 15 Uhesabuni uvumilivu wa Bwana wetu kuwa wokovu. Paulo, ndugu yetu mpendwa, aliwaandikia pia kuhusu jambo hili, kwa hekima ambayo Mungu alimpa. \v 16 Anafanya hivyo katika barua zake zote anapozungumza juu ya mambo haya. Baadhi ya mambo ndani yake ni magumu kueleweka, na watu wasiofundishwa na wasio thabiti huyapindisha, kama wanavyoyapindisha Maandiko mengine, na hivyo wanajiletea maangamizi yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, wapendwa wangu, mnapongojea mambo haya, jitahidini kuishi maisha safi yasiyo na kosa lolote. Kisha Bwana atakapokuja, atawakuta mkiishi kwa amani. \v 15 Kumbukeni kwamba Bwana wetu ni mvumilivu kwa sababu anataka watu waokolewe. Ndugu yetu mpendwa Paulo pia aliwaandikia kuhusu jambo hili, kwa hekima ambayo Mungu alimpa. \v 16 Anaandika kuhusu mambo haya katika barua zake zote. Baadhi ya mambo katika barua zake ni magumu kueleweka. Watu ambao hawakufundishwa vizuri na ambao hawasimami imara huyapindisha maneno yake ili yamaanishe kitu kingine. Wanafanya vivyo hivyo na Maandiko mengine. Mwishowe jambo hilo litawaangamiza.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, bien-aimés, en attendant ces choses, efforcez-vous d’être trouvés par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sans tache et irréprochables, dans la paix, \v 15 et considérez la patience de notre Seigneur [comme un] salut, comme notre bien-aimé frère Paul vous l’a aussi écrit selon la sagesse qui lui a été donnée, \v 16 comme [il le fait] aussi dans toutes [ses] lettres, où il parle de ces choses, dans lesquelles il y a des points difficiles à comprendre, que les gens ignorants et mal affermis tordent, comme [ils le font] aussi des autres Écritures, pour leur propre destruction.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, chers amis, pendant que vous attendez ces choses, faites tous vos efforts pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous trouve sans tache et sans reproche, dans la paix. \v 15 Considérez la patience de notre Seigneur comme une chance de salut. Paul, notre cher frère, vous a aussi écrit à ce sujet, avec la sagesse que Dieu lui a donnée. \v 16 Il le fait dans toutes ses lettres quand il parle de ces choses. Il s’y trouve des passages difficiles à comprendre, que des gens ignorants et instables déforment, comme ils déforment aussi les autres Écritures, et ils causent ainsi leur propre destruction.
fr.R: Alors, chers amis, pendant que vous attendez ces choses, faites tous vos efforts pour vivre une vie pure, sans rien de mauvais. Ainsi, quand le Seigneur viendra, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous trouvera en paix. \v 15 Souvenez-vous que notre Seigneur est patient parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut que les gens soient sauvés. Notre cher frère Paul vous a aussi écrit à ce sujet, avec la sagesse que Dieu lui a donnée. \v 16 Il parle de ces choses dans toutes ses lettres. Dans ses lettres, certaines choses sont difficiles à comprendre. Des gens qui n’ont pas été bien enseignés et qui ne tiennent pas ferme déforment ce qu’il a écrit pour lui faire dire autre chose. Ils font la même chose avec le reste des Écritures. À la fin, cela les détruira.

ko.L: 그러므로 사랑하는 여러분, 이것들을 기다리면서, 그분께 티도 없고 흠도 없이 평안 가운데 발견되도록 힘쓰십시오. \v 15 그리고 우리 주님의 오래 참으심을 구원으로 여기십시오. 우리가 사랑하는 형제 바울도 그가 받은 지혜를 따라 여러분에게 그렇게 썼습니다. \v 16 그는 모든 편지에서 이 일들에 대하여 말할 때에 그렇게 말합니다. 그 편지들 가운데에는 알기 어려운 것이 더러 있어서, 배우지 못하고 굳게 서지 못한 사람들이 다른 성경들을 그렇게 하듯이 그것들을 억지로 풀다가 스스로 멸망에 이릅니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 사랑하는 여러분, 이런 일들을 기다리는 동안, 그분 앞에서 티도 없고 흠도 없이 평안한 가운데 있도록 힘쓰십시오. \v 15 우리 주님께서 오래 참으시는 것을 구원의 기회로 여기십시오. 우리가 사랑하는 형제 바울도 하나님께서 그에게 주신 지혜를 따라 여러분에게 이것에 대해 썼습니다. \v 16 그는 모든 편지에서 이런 일들을 말할 때 그렇게 합니다. 그 편지들에는 깨닫기 어려운 것들이 더러 있습니다. 그래서 배우지 못하고 흔들리는 사람들이 다른 성경을 비틀듯이 그것들을 비틀어서 스스로 멸망을 불러옵니다.
ko.R: 그러니 사랑하는 여러분, 이런 일들을 기다리는 동안 깨끗하고 아무 잘못이 없는 삶을 살도록 힘쓰십시오. 그러면 주님께서 오실 때, 여러분이 평안 가운데 살고 있는 것을 보실 것입니다. \v 15 우리 주님께서 오래 참으시는 것은 사람들이 구원받기를 원하시기 때문이라는 것을 기억하십시오. 우리가 사랑하는 형제 바울도 하나님께서 주신 지혜로 여러분에게 이것에 대해 썼습니다. \v 16 그는 모든 편지에서 이런 일들에 대해 씁니다. 그의 편지에는 이해하기 어려운 것들이 더러 있습니다. 잘 배우지 못하고 굳게 서지 못한 사람들은 그가 쓴 것을 비틀어서 다른 뜻으로 만듭니다. 그들은 다른 성경에도 똑같이 합니다. 결국 그 일이 그들을 멸망하게 할 것입니다.

decisions.choice: spotless and blameless: pure, with nothing to stain or spoil them
decisions.reason: The words describe an unblemished sacrifice (1 Peter 1:19). They are the reverse of the false teachers, whom Peter calls stains and blemishes (2:13).

decisions.choice: found by him: found so by the Lord at his coming
decisions.reason: αὐτῷ names the one who finds them, the Lord whose day has just been described. "Found" picks up 3:10: on that day everything will be found as it is.

decisions.choice: in peace: at peace with God and living in peace, with nothing to fear
decisions.reason: Peace is the greeting of 1:2 and the state of those who are ready for the Lord's coming.

decisions.choice: the Lord's patience means salvation: the time he gives is for people to be saved
decisions.reason: This answers the scoffers once more (3:4, 3:9). What they call slowness is the time the Lord gives for people to repent and be saved.

decisions.choice: Paul wrote to these readers about the same thing; the letter is not named
alternatives: a particular letter such as Romans
decisions.reason: Peter does not say which letter he means. Paul speaks of God's patience leading to repentance in Romans 2:4, and of being blameless at the Lord's coming in 1 Thessalonians 5:23 and 1 Corinthians 1:8. "Our beloved brother" shows Peter honoring Paul as a fellow apostle (compare Galatians 2:9).

decisions.choice: in which: in the letters, following the SBLGNT
alternatives: in which things: in the subjects Paul writes about
decisions.reason: αἷς is feminine and refers to the letters. From general knowledge, many later manuscripts read οἷς, a form that would refer to the matters Paul discusses. The sense changes little. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the untaught and unstable twist them: people without teaching and without a firm footing distort them
decisions.reason: στρεβλόω means to wrench or twist, as on a rack. ἀστήρικτος, "unstable", echoes 1:12 and 3:17: the readers are to stand firm, unlike these people.

decisions.choice: the other scriptures: Paul's letters are counted with the Scriptures
alternatives: the other writings, in a general sense
Paul's letters are compared with the Scriptures, not counted among them
decisions.reason: Everywhere else in the New Testament γραφή means the sacred Scriptures. "The other" (λοιπὰς) puts Paul's letters in the same group: people twist them just as they twist the rest of Scripture. The sentence shows that Paul's letters were being read and valued alongside the Scriptures of Israel when this letter was written; it does not say which other writings were included.

decisions.choice: to their own destruction: the twisting leads to their ruin at the judgment
decisions.reason: ἀπώλεια is the destruction of the ungodly in 3:7 and of the false teachers in 2:1-3.

decisions.choice: three English sentences after the command
decisions.reason: The long Greek sentence is broken so the remarks about Paul and his letters can be followed.

decisions.choice: the wisdom God gave him
decisions.reason: The passive implies that God gave the wisdom. Readable says the same.

decisions.choice: when the Lord comes, he will find you; because he wants people to be saved
alternatives: to be found by him; consider the patience of our Lord salvation
decisions.reason: Readable names the Lord as the one who finds them (m2) and explains how patience means salvation (m4).

decisions.choice: kupindisha ("huyapindisha")
decisions.reason: στρεβλόω is to wrench or twist something out of shape (m7). "Kupindisha" (to bend, twist) keeps that picture; "kupotosha" (to lead astray, mislead) names the result rather than the act.

decisions.choice: les autres Écritures, capitalised
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (m8) reads the word as Scripture, with Paul’s letters counted among the Scriptures, so French uses the capital it gives the Scriptures elsewhere; "écrits" would leave the point unclear.

decisions.choice: "우리가 사랑하는 형제 바울", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Brother" here is one particular man, Paul, so it takes no gender span; "우리가 사랑하는" gives the Greek "our beloved".

decisions.choice: "다른 성경들" (L); "다른 성경" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "the other scriptures" as the Scriptures, among which Paul's letters are counted, and footnotes it. "성경" says Scripture; "글" would make them ordinary writings.

source.text: ὑμεῖς οὖν, ἀγαπητοί, προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ, αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: You therefore, beloved, knowing beforehand, guard yourselves so that not by the of the lawless error having been carried away you fall from the own firmness, \v 18 grow but in grace and knowledge of the Lord of us and Savior Jesus Christ.

en.L: You therefore, beloved, knowing [this] beforehand, guard yourselves, so that you do not, carried away by the error of the lawless, fall from your own firm footing, \v 18 but grow in grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: So, dear friends, since you have been told this in advance, be on your guard. Do not let the error of lawless people sweep you along and knock you off your own firm footing. \v 18 Instead, keep growing in the grace that comes from our Lord and Savior Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and in knowing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Dear friends, now you know these things ahead of time. So be careful. Do not let the false ideas of people who reject God's law carry you away. Do not let them pull you down from the firm place where you stand. \v 18 Instead, keep growing in the grace that our Lord and Savior Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gives, and keep getting to know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} better.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, entonces, amados, conociendo [esto] de antemano, {{plural_you:cuídense|guardaos}}, para que, arrastrados junto [con otros] por el extravío de los sin ley, no {{plural_you:caigan|caigáis}} de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} propia firmeza, \v 18 sino {{plural_you:crezcan|creced}} en [la] gracia y [el] conocimiento de nuestro Señor y Salvador {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Así que, queridos, ya que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido advertidos de antemano, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} en guardia. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que el error de la gente sin ley {{plural_you:los|os}} arrastre y {{plural_you:los|os}} haga caer de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} propia posición firme. \v 18 Más bien, {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} creciendo en la gracia que viene de nuestro Señor y Salvador {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, y en el conocimiento de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Queridos amigos, ahora ya {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} estas cosas de antemano. Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que las ideas falsas de la gente que rechaza la ley de Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} arrastren. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:los|os}} hagan caer del lugar firme donde {{plural_you:están|estáis}}. \v 18 Más bien, {{plural_you:sigan|seguid}} creciendo en la gracia que da nuestro Señor y Salvador {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}. Y {{plural_you:procuren|procurad}} que cada día {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}} mejor.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo ninyi, wapendwa, mkiwa mmejua [hili] kabla, jihadharini, ili mkichukuliwa pamoja [na wengine] na upotofu wa wasiofuata sheria, msianguke kutoka katika uimara wenu wenyewe, \v 18 bali kueni katika neema na ujuzi wa Bwana wetu na Mwokozi Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, wapendwa, kwa kuwa mmeambiwa haya mapema, kaeni macho. Msikubali upotofu wa watu wasiofuata sheria uwachukue na kuwaangusha kutoka mahali penu imara. \v 18 Badala yake, endeleeni kukua katika neema inayotoka kwa Bwana wetu na Mwokozi Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na katika kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.R: Wapendwa wangu, sasa mnayajua mambo haya kabla hayajatokea. Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu. Msikubali mawazo ya uongo ya watu wanaokataa sheria ya Mungu yawachukue. Msikubali wawaangushe kutoka mahali imara mnaposimama. \v 18 Badala yake, endeleeni kukua katika neema ambayo Bwana wetu na Mwokozi Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anawapa, na endeleeni kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} vizuri zaidi.

fr.L: Vous donc, bien-aimés, sachant [cela] d’avance, tenez-vous sur vos gardes, de peur qu’entraînés par l’égarement des gens sans loi, vous ne tombiez de votre propre fermeté, \v 18 mais grandissez dans la grâce et la connaissance de notre Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Ainsi, chers amis, puisque vous êtes avertis à l’avance, soyez sur vos gardes. Ne laissez pas l’égarement des gens sans loi vous entraîner et vous faire perdre votre propre stabilité. \v 18 Au contraire, continuez à grandir dans la grâce que donne notre Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, et à mieux {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaître.
fr.R: Chers amis, maintenant vous savez ces choses à l’avance. Alors faites attention. Ne laissez pas les idées fausses des gens qui rejettent la loi de Dieu vous emporter. Ne les laissez pas vous faire tomber de l’endroit solide où vous vous tenez. \v 18 Au contraire, continuez à grandir dans la grâce que donne notre Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, et apprenez à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaître toujours mieux.

ko.L: 그러므로 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분은 [이것을] 미리 알고 있으니, 무법한 사람들의 미혹에 휩쓸려 여러분 자신의 굳센 자리에서 떨어지지 않도록 스스로 조심하십시오. \v 18 그리고 우리 주님이시며 구주이신 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 은혜와 [그분을 아는] 지식 안에서 자라십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분은 이것을 미리 들었으니 조심하십시오. 무법한 사람들의 잘못에 휩쓸려 여러분이 굳게 서 있는 자리에서 떨어지지 않게 하십시오. \v 18 오히려 우리 주님이시며 구주이신 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주시는 은혜와 그분을 아는 지식 안에서 계속 자라십시오.
ko.R: 사랑하는 여러분, 이제 여러분은 이런 일들을 미리 알게 되었습니다. 그러니 조심하십시오. 하나님의 법을 거부하는 사람들의 그릇된 생각에 휩쓸리지 마십시오. 여러분이 굳게 서 있는 자리에서 그들이 여러분을 끌어내리지 못하게 하십시오. \v 18 오히려 우리 주님이시며 구주이신 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주시는 은혜 안에서 계속 자라고, 그분을 더 잘 알아 가십시오.

decisions.choice: knowing beforehand: warned in advance by this letter
decisions.reason: προγινώσκω here means to know ahead of time. Peter has told them what the scoffers and false teachers will say (3:3; 2:1), so they will not be taken by surprise.

decisions.choice: carried away by the error of the lawless: swept along by the false teachers' wrong way
decisions.reason: ἄθεσμος describes people who keep no law or principle; Peter used it of the people of Sodom (2:7). πλάνη is wandering from the truth, and συναπάγομαι is to be carried off together with others.

decisions.choice: your own firm footing: the stable place where you stand in the truth
decisions.reason: στηριγμός is firmness or a fixed position. It answers "unstable" in 3:16 and recalls 1:12, where the readers are "established in the truth".

decisions.choice: grace and knowledge of our Lord: grace that comes from him and knowledge of him
alternatives: both grace and knowledge belong to the Lord in the same way
decisions.reason: The genitive "of our Lord" goes with both nouns, but differently: the Lord gives grace, and he is the one known. Knowing him is the theme the letter began with (1:2-3, 1:8).

decisions.choice: grace that comes from ...; and in knowing him
alternatives: grace and knowledge of our Lord
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the two senses of the genitive (m4).

decisions.choice: the false ideas of people who reject God's law
decisions.reason: Readable explains "lawless" (m2) and "error" in plain words.

source.text: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος. ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: To him the glory both now and to day of eternity. Amen.

en.L: To {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [be] the glory, both now and to [the] day of eternity. Amen.
en.B: May glory be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}, both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
en.R: May all glory be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}, now and on that day that will never end. Amen.

es.L: A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [sea] la gloria, tanto ahora como hasta [el] día de [la] eternidad. Amén.
es.B: Que la gloria sea {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}, ahora y hasta el día de la eternidad. Amén.
es.R: Que toda la gloria sea {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}, ahora y en aquel día que nunca terminará. Amén.

sw.L: Kwake [uwe] utukufu, sasa na hata siku ya milele. Amina.
sw.B: Utukufu na uwe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, sasa na hadi siku ya milele. Amina.
sw.R: Utukufu wote na uwe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, sasa na siku ile isiyo na mwisho. Amina.

fr.L: À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [soit] la gloire, maintenant et jusqu’au jour de l’éternité. Amen.
fr.B: À {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} soit la gloire, maintenant et jusqu’au jour de l’éternité. Amen.
fr.R: Que toute la gloire {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} revienne, maintenant et en ce jour qui ne finira jamais. Amen.

ko.L: 영광이 이제와 영원한 날까지 그분께 [있기를 빕니다]. 아멘.
ko.B: 영광이 지금도, 영원한 날까지도 그분께 있기를 빕니다. 아멘.
ko.R: 지금도, 그리고 결코 끝나지 않을 그날에도 모든 영광이 그분께 있기를 빕니다. 아멘.

decisions.choice: one record: the doxology and its closing Amen
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT puts a full stop before ἀμήν, but the Amen is the response that seals the doxology, not a sentence of its own. It is kept with the words it answers, as in Philippians 4:20.

decisions.choice: to him: to Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: αὐτῷ refers to "our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ" just named. Most New Testament doxologies give glory to God; this one gives it to Christ, as 2 Timothy 4:18 and Revelation 1:5-6 also do.

decisions.choice: a prayer of praise: may the glory be his
alternatives: a statement: the glory is his
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. Doxologies like this are usually read as wishes or praise ("be"), though they also state what is true.

decisions.choice: the day of eternity: the day that begins the age to come and never ends
decisions.reason: The phrase is found only here in the New Testament. It recalls "the day of God" (3:12): the day that brings in eternity, which has no evening.

decisions.choice: Amen, following the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: From general knowledge, a few manuscripts, Codex Vaticanus among them, end without the Amen; most include it. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: on that day that will never end
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase (m4).

decisions.choice: Kwake, no span
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek order, so "Kwake" (to him) opens the sentence and is capitalised anyway; a span would have nothing to change. Balanced and Readable put "utukufu" first and carry the span on "wake".

decisions.choice: "그분께 있기를 빕니다" (a wish) at every level, with the honorific for Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this doxology as a prayer of praise to Jesus Christ, unlike 1 Peter 4:11 and 5:11, which it reads as statements; Korean marks the difference with "빕니다".
